images.heading: Page images
images.intro: Every image on the site, grouped by page. Replace one here and every place it appears changes with it.
images.accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB.
images.previewHint: Cropped to this slot’s {ratio} frame, the way the page shows it.
images.pendingCount: No pending replacements | 1 image replaced, not saved | {count} images replaced, not saved
images.onSave: The server has optimized this image. Save the draft, then publish it to make it visible to visitors.

errors.type: That file type is not supported. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.
errors.size: That file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.read: The image could not be read.

warnings.tooSmall: This image is {width}px wide; this slot needs at least {min}px, so it would look soft.
warnings.cropped: Its ratio ({actual}) differs from the slot’s ({slot}); the edges will be cropped — check the preview.

images.slotsHint: One image per place on this page. Each is independent — changing one never changes another.
images.noSlots: This page has no section images.
images.removed: Removed — the page shows its placeholder
images.galleryHint: A free set of pictures shown near the end of this page. Nothing appears on the page while it is empty.
images.galleryEmpty: No pictures in this page’s gallery yet.
images.addHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB each. Several at once.
images.altMissing: Add a description in both languages — gallery pictures have no text beside them.
images.changes: No image changes | 1 image change | {count} image changes

live.upToDate: Published content is up to date

live.restoreDone: Version restored as a draft. Review it before publishing.
live.failed: Could not complete the request. Your edits are still here; try again.
live.conflict: A newer version was saved in another tab. Your edits are preserved here. Copy anything you need, then reload the saved version.
live.expired: Your session expired. Open sign-in in another tab, then reload this page after copying your unsaved edits.
live.publishConfirm: Publish this saved revision to the English and Arabic website? This records your approval of its changes.
live.reloadConfirm: Reload the latest saved draft? This discards your unsaved edits.
live.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved edits. Discard them and sign out?

live.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
live.brandApproval: Approve only company-confirmed copy. Draft fields remain private, even when other changes are published.
live.noHistory: No content changes yet. Start by editing a page or reviewing brand content.
live.restoreConfirm: Restore revision {number} as a new draft? The live website will stay unchanged until you publish.
